name: Timothy Hepburn
office: City of La Verne, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Timothy Hepburn is a member of the La Verne City Council, representing District 4. He serves as the city's Mayor. He is a business owner. In 2024, he was an electrical contractor and president of the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments. He became Mayor in 2020. The council unanimously selected him to continue as Mayor in 2025.

sentences.text: Timothy Hepburn is a member of the La Verne City Council, representing District 4.
He serves as the city's Mayor.
In 2024, he was an electrical contractor and president of the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments.
The council unanimously selected him to continue as Mayor in 2025.

items.text: At a 2017 candidate forum, he said undocumented workers who commit felonies should be deported and he supported a more bicycle-friendly city. In 2026, he voted to declare a state of emergency after a lithium-ion battery fire and said the priority was starting the claims process for evacuees.
